description: Fresh synthetic timing prompts, fixed before first run. Eight categories, 512 output tokens each; no quality or completion claim.

prompts.name: c-zigzag-varint
prompts.prompt: Write a C11 incremental decoder for unsigned LEB128 followed by ZigZag decoding to int64_t. Input arrives in arbitrary chunks. Distinguish NEED_MORE, DONE and INVALID; reject noncanonical encodings and 64-bit overflow without shifting by 64. Include the state structure, implementation, and tests for split boundaries and INT64_MIN. Start directly with code.

prompts.name: python-toposort
prompts.prompt: Write Python code to topologically order a dependency graph where dependencies may be missing and duplicate edges may appear. Return deterministic lexicographic order, or one concrete directed cycle with its closing vertex repeated. Do not use recursion or external libraries. Provide tests for a self-loop, disconnected nodes, missing dependencies and a long chain. Start with code.

prompts.name: rust-slice-iterator
prompts.prompt: Implement a safe Rust iterator that groups consecutive equal values in a borrowed slice and yields each maximal group as a borrowed subslice. It must support DoubleEndedIterator and work correctly when next and next_back are interleaved. Use no unsafe code or heap allocation. Explain the invariant and give tests including empty, all equal and alternating slices. Start with the implementation.

prompts.name: cpp-integer-geometry
prompts.prompt: Implement C++20 segment intersection classification for integer points: disjoint, one point, or a nonzero collinear overlap. Coordinates fit signed 32-bit integers. Avoid floating point, integer overflow and exceptions. Include degenerate zero-length segments, a careful orientation function, and tests. Explain why ordinary int64_t cross products are insufficient at the extreme coordinate range.

prompts.name: reasoning-recovery
prompts.prompt: A service writes a payload file, an index entry and a committed marker as three separate durable operations, with a crash possible between any two. Clients may retry with the same identifier but a different payload. Design a recovery protocol that never returns the wrong payload and never acknowledges a request that recovery can discard. State exactly what assumptions are required and reason through every crash boundary. Do not assume rename or a database transaction is available.

prompts.name: factual-comparison
prompts.prompt: Explain the differences among a solar day, a sidereal day and an orbital period, using Earth and Venus as examples. Explain retrograde rotation and why one must distinguish a planet's rotation period from its sunrise-to-sunrise day. Use approximate values where useful and clearly distinguish established facts from analogy. Then describe a simple classroom demonstration.

prompts.name: prose-continuation
prompts.prompt: Continue this scene for several paragraphs. Keep it grounded, avoid supernatural explanations, and reveal the disagreement indirectly through action rather than exposition: Mara unlocked the observatory just before dawn. Someone had moved the old brass clock from the wall to the floor, face down, and left a cup of cold tea on its former hook. Her brother was already at the telescope. Neither of them mentioned the letter.

prompts.name: easy-counting-anchor
prompts.prompt: Easy throughput sanity anchor: count upward from 1 in order, one integer per line, with no prose. Continue until the output limit.
